task: Classify microsatellite instability status in gastric adenocarcinoma. Classes: MSI vs. MSS. Key H&E clues for MSI include dense tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, Crohn-like peritumoral lymphoid aggregates, mucinous change, and poor gland formation compared with more conventional MSS tumors.

classes.0: MSI gastric adenocarcinoma with prominent lymphocytic infiltration, lymphoid aggregates, and often mucinous or poorly differentiated morphology.
classes.1: MSS gastric adenocarcinoma with more conventional gland-forming morphology and less conspicuous lymphoid reaction.
